This manual is pro-vided for your equipment and should be considered a part of that equipment. All personnel responsible for the operation and maintenance of the equipment should read and thoroughly understand this manual.Before preparing the equipment for normal service, complete all safety checks, remove all tools and foreign objects from the equipment, ensure all guards are in place and securely fastened, and alert area personnel that the equipment will be starting.4.2 Starting and stopping proceduresBy default, the fire pump drive engine will turn on automatically when low system water pressure is sensed by the pump controller.
